cohort: The study cohort consisted of 130 postpartum women with PE and 192 postpartum women without PE.
finding: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) and abnormal echocardiography were identified as independent risk factors for PE in postpartum women, with d-dimer levels > 2.24 mg/L serving as a specific marker for clinical monitoring.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was significantly more common in the PE group compared to the non-PE group.
